description: This file defines the Manufacturer controller class for the Opencart admin catalog module. It manages CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, and other functionalities related to manufacturers within the admin interface.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Controller class for managing manufacturers in the admin catalog, including listing, editing, creating, enabling/disabling, and deleting manufacturer records.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main manufacturer list page with filters and links to other operations.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer list view as part of an AJAX or partial page load.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns a paginated list of manufacturers based on filters and sorting options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of a manufacturer, including validation and SEO URL management.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected manufacturers after checking for associated products.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for manufacturer names.
